findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_social_posts, online_article_create, online_article_get, online_article_update, online_content_get, online_material_sections_get, online_material_section_publish, online_content_edit, online_teacher_profiles_get, online_article_audio_set, online_media_prepare · Private data: list_lesson_options, search_lesson_availability, create_lesson_request, online_article_create, online_article_publish, online_articles_list, online_content_get, online_material_sections_get, online_material_section_publish, online_content_edit, online_teacher_profiles_get, online_content_preview, online_media_prepare · Public sink: create_social_post_draft, publish_social_post, online_article_create, online_article_publish, online_material_sections_get, online_material_section_save, online_material_section_publish, online_content_edit, online_teacher_profiles_set.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_social_posts, online_article_create, online_article_get, online_article_update, online_content_get, online_material_sections_get, online_material_section_publish, online_content_edit, online_teacher_profiles_get, online_article_audio_set, online_media_prepare · Private data: list_lesson_options, search_lesson_availability, create_lesson_request, online_article_create, online_article_publish, online_articles_list, online_content_get, online_material_sections_get, online_material_section_publish, online_content_edit, online_teacher_profiles_get, online_content_preview, online_media_prepare · Public sink: create_social_post_draft, publish_social_post, online_article_create, online_article_publish, online_material_sections_get, online_material_section_save, online_material_section_publish, online_content_edit, online_teacher_profiles_set

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
